reviews.text: chelsea was proper brilliant in grooming my dog. she always wags her tail when she sees chelsea.. and that means a lot - for real.
My dogs Summer and Suosuo have been coming here for a long while now and they are always so looked after and come out with lovely haircuts that suit their needs. 😁 Thanx so much!!!!! 🪲🖤 …

I can’t recommend this groomer highly enough! They are simply the best. My dog, Mars, and I absolutely loooove them! 🐾
They always do an amazing job, treat Mars with so much love and care, and make the whole experience stress-free. Mars comes home looking fantastic and happy every single time

My cocker spaniel is a difficult dog and is scared from other dogs but when he goes for his hair cut he come out happy and excited for the rest of the day. The team is amazing and always ready to help with any request.

Would give 0 stars if I could! Absolutely unacceptable service!! My poor puppy was returned with severe matting behind his ears! and now since his had the grooming he is now distressed and wont allow anyone to touch that area. It’s something that he never had an issue with before. This suggests to me that very rough or careless handling. What makes it worse is that I was not informed at all during or after the appointment! which this shows a complete lack of professionalism and duty of care. If there were issues I should have been called and told immediately. Instead I was left to discover the problem my self after him coming home. Extremely disappointing and concerning experience. I will not be returning and would not recommend this groomer to anyone who cares about their pet’s welfare.
Groom Dog City do a great job of trimming the nails of my overly dramatic pug. Very professional, and always with a smile. Highly recommended
Absolutely impeccable service, time after time. Stuart and this team are consummate professionals. Our Welsh Terrier looks adorable. Thank you!
Lovely groomers. I have been bringing my 2 boys here for over ten years. Very kind and gentle with my little rescue dog. Stu and the team are brilliant. Thank you!

We have been going for a while to them, however yesterday we had a really bad experience. The dog had some knots on the front legs, something minor, but nothing on the body face neck tail or back legs. They told me they will shave her because they couldn’t do anything better for the knots. I left her which I shouldn’t have as already there were quite rude in the communication enquiring me about how did I care for my dog  implying that I don’t brush her, which is not true and obvious given that she only had few knots on the front legs. She is a cockapoo super curly who plays crazy in the park. We got a complete shaved dog back, I really regretted I left her to be honest, not sure what was the point. The family was so sad to see her that way and the dog is so sad, this morning was not even  playing . We don’t understand why they refused to dedicate some time to fix the front leg knots as she was not bad at all only few knots. My friend with same type of dog (poodle mixed)  did not understand why they shaved her as she was not bad, neither my sister that is a vet and said they just did not want to put the effort on sorting the knots. It was a late appointment too at 4:30 which usually last two hours which may be why.  I knew I should not leave her because the communication overall was quite tense and inquisitive.
We have been taking our Norfolk terrier here for the last 5 years and have never had a bad haircut. The team are lovely and always put Bear at ease, making sure he's comfortable during the process

I had a very disappointing experience at this groomer and would not recommend them.

I brought my fairly large Akita/Shepherd mix in for a full groom. My dog is naturally anxious, and instead of being handled with patience and care, it felt like she was rushed through the process. They had multiple dogs being groomed at the same time, which only adds to the stress for anxious dogs. It honestly felt more like they were focused on getting as many dogs in and out as possible rather than providing quality care.

When I picked her up, I immediately noticed areas that were not properly cleaned or brushed. My dog had dried discharge around her nipples before the appointment, and I specifically expected that to be fully cleaned during a full groom. That area wasn’t cleaned at all. It was still clearly there when we got home. It also didn’t seem like she was thoroughly brushed out.

For the amount they charge, I expected much better attention to detail and overall care. My dog also came out looking stressed, which makes me feel she did not have a good experience.

I won’t be returning and cannot recommend this groomer to others looking for careful, attentive service, especially if you have a large or anxious dog.
Great Customer Service very helpful very welcoming very happy with the service if you have a dog that’s nervous getting their nails cut go to this place
The best one of dog grooming and design in London

Hands down the best groomers in London. We've been bringing our Yorkie, Stevie here for 3 years and I wouldn't go anywhere else. Antonio is his regular groomer and does such a fantastic job we always get stopped in the street and everyone always comments on his cut, you get what you pay for and the team are skilled here. We've also used other groomers in the shop when Antonio has been booked and they do just as good a job, they keep notes on their system on specific things I've asked for so he always looks great on pick up. I must give them a shout out on their flexibility too, they are always willing to change appointments as and when I need to because of work etc. Wonderful team of people and Stevie is always so happy and eager to get inside!
We’ve been bringing Poe our dog here for 3+ years and the team are always amazing. They do a gorgeous hand strip and make his butt look super peachy! Great results and customer service.
I have been going to Groom Dog City since Charlie was a puppy for 4 years now. The team is fantastic, they listen well and take a lot of care while grooming. Charlie especially loves Chelsea 🥰 …
We take Rexie here and have for many years. She’s not the easiest (chihuahua; enough said) but they have never had to muzzle her. They listen and work with her. Highly recommend them.

A wonderful salon for dogs. Rui is visibly excited as we approach GDC! The groomers here have taken the time to understand Rui and make the whole experience a pleasure. Thanks again for a great groom taking us into autumn 😍 …

We’ve been bringing our toy poodle to Groom Dog City for 2 years now and we couldn’t be happier. Chelsea is absolutely amazing, our dog adores her and always comes back looking perfect. We get so many compliments after the grooming. The whole team is super friendly, professional, and clearly cares about the dogs. Highly recommend!
Always friendly and Gilbert loves the team (always comes out looking very handsome)
I have been using  groom dog city for a long time  Rute allways dose my dog olly such a lovely lady I wud not go anywhere else

I came here last week for the first time and was so impressed with the team! Can only speak on nail clipping as haven't needed grooming but took my Puggle here for the first time to see if they could help cutting one very long curled nail, I would have been happy if they managed this but actually we realised that all the nails needed doing and between two of the staff, they were able to do all the nails! and without any fuss, they were super up for it, friendly, confident and pretty unfazed. I was so relieved and this is super impressive as my Vet's needed 3+ staff last time and still then didn't do a good job or even get all of the nails, whilst traumatising my dog. My dog is the sweetest and doesn't bite but he literally screams his head off, he's so scared of it and needs some serious muscle to keep a hold of when trying to do this task. We're not even able to do 1 nail at home so this was an amazing service and will be coming back each time it's needed! Thanks so much to the team and for your flexibility with us popping in. So appreciate it!!
Antonio is just amazing! Thank you so much. Absolutely amazing cut. He knows what we want for Brownie and always meet our expectations. Needs to be a teddy bear cut like my daughter says :)

I really hate to give bad reviews. But I took my toy poodle in today the cut was worse than horrible. I could have done a better job and saved myself nearly £100 . When I complained a large women with an accent was rude and said what do you want me to do about it? Really your dogs old and I remember your dog it’s special…. Love your special extremely special. There was a lovely guy who offered to rectify the horrific job she had done and she then asked him ‘ why’ …. I mean why is he rectifying the worst dog cut I have ever seen? I would never return I’m fuming . No apology no customer service my dog is a toy poodle and looks like an old mutt !!
Antonio did an amazing job, highly recommend!
Took my dog Vinnie for a wash and trim, he looked even more gorgeous afterwards! Thanks to the team for the care and great work!
Great service
This is the best hair cut Nacho has ever had. Went in nervous ... left with my tail wagging. Great job and good attention to detail... cut to exactly how we asked.

I've been going to this place for almost 8 years and I've always loved Buddy's grooming and everyone already knew that they weren't supposed to touch his tail, I always made that clear. He had problems with growth hair there and it was never cut before so it took his whole life to grow, when I made the complaint immediately upon noticing one of the workers with a mocking tone said that there was nothing they could do, completely disrespectful and lack of attentionto a regular customer.

EDIT... REPLY TO STU.... You are fully aware of this OLD review i left at the time, as we had words on the phone after you ignored original review, emails and msg i left you!! H was only 7 months old and your Trainee left her paws bleeding from 1pm till late evening. This was dealt with at the time and you guys are the reason for her terror at the groomers. As you well know Stu. As for other groomers, shes been to two girls who were wonderful, but sadly moved up north. No issues. Yesterday i tried another groomer, but sadly watched them through the shop window dancing, around, chatting, just shaving her n getting on with the job, without much acknowledgement of her stress, with other issues, so i left a review. My original request to join a traini g programme 6 YEARS AGO, is irrelevant..........Sadly won't be returning, trainees doing poor jobs, my dog got injured and was in pain hours later, they didn't even bother telling me at collection time.
It's  massively over priced for the quality of the groom.... It's a no no for me and all my clients. Didn't even bother replying to my complaint let alone apologise! Shame, cos I liked the owner, but I guess it's not enough.

TLDR: Our Schnauzer never looked so good! Impeccable service. Highly recommend.

Not Just a Hair Cut
Stuart and his team are super friendly, whilst being so professional.   They do an amazing job with my  Very Yappy, pet Shitzu Edie. and they still love her. …

Great experience taking my 2 year old Bichon Frise to Groom Dog City. Easy to book. Great communication. They only work on one dog at a time so they are very quick. Only took one hour for my dog to have a full groom. My pup looked perfect …
If you’ve got a Chow Chow and looking for a groomer, Rute has got you covered. 10/10 highly recommend!!!
